fact: The Ethiopian Statistical Service and ICF published the Summary Report of the 2024-25 EDHS, a nationally representative survey of 22,540 households fielded August 2024 to April 2025; the date is the document's proxy published date.
The Ethiopian Statistical Service and ICF released the Key Indicators Report of the 2024-25 EDHS (22,540 households, fieldwork August 2024 to April 2025), dated January 2026 on its cover.
ESS states Ethiopia has conducted three national censuses, in 1984, 1994 and 2007; the 2007 census is the latest.
ESS lists the country-level Statistical Report and Analytical Report on Housing Characteristics of the 2007 census as downloadable main reports; no release date is given, so the census year is used.
A State Minister of Planning and Development cited full dissemination of the Demographic and Health Survey at a national conference on 18 May 2026.
